title: Regulatory roles of bioactive lipids in vascular homeostasis and remodeling
authors: Jie Yang; Haiyan Xiao; Zhongze Zhang; Liuyang Zhang; Xu Zhang
abstract: Bioactive lipids regulate vascular health by signaling through synthesis, localization, and inactivation pathways.
